title: One-on-One Remote Tech Training
headline: Learn everyday technology skills through patient, live online instruction.
description: One-on-one online training for computers, phones, accounts, internet safety, and common digital tasks. No Remote Support Plan is required.
metaTitle: One-on-One Online Tech Training | Defend I.T. Solutions
metaDescription: Get patient, live online help with computers, phones, email, passwords, backups, online safety, and common digital tasks. No support plan required.

sections.heading: Did You Know?
paragraph: Learning with your own device and real tasks makes it easier to apply each step after the session.
One-on-one sessions can focus on the features and problems that matter to you.
A short lesson on passwords, scams, and account recovery can prevent common mistakes.

sections.heading: Who This Helps
paragraph: This service is for beginners, older adults, families, and everyday users who want patient help with the technology they use.
Choose training when the goal is to learn a task, build confidence, or develop safer online habits.

sections.heading: Popular Topics
items: Computer basics, file organization, and web browsing
Windows, macOS, smartphone navigation, and settings
Password managers, multi-factor authentication, and account recovery
Online shopping, banking, and scam recognition
Privacy and digital safety for individuals and families

sections.heading: How Sessions Work
paragraph: Remote training is available online across the United States and does not require the Remote Support Plan.
Bring your questions or choose a topic before the session. We work at your pace and focus on the tasks you want to learn.
We explain how to join the online session before the appointment.

faq.question: Is this service only for beginners?
faq.answer: No. Sessions are adjusted to your experience, but the service is especially useful for people who want patient help with everyday technology.

faq.question: Do I need a Remote Support Plan for training?
faq.answer: No. Remote training is booked separately and is available online across the United States.

faq.question: Can you help a family member who is not comfortable with technology?
faq.answer: Yes. Sessions use clear instructions, practical examples, and a pace that fits the learner.
